testcase.name: Scenario: extrusion-13 Join adds a boss to one body: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/solid-model/extrusion/extrusion.feature:146:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: extrusion-13 Join adds a boss to one body ✔> Given the MCAD Software is displaying a part in the solid modeling workspace ✔> And the viewport pointer is idle ✔ Given a copy of `fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-base-circle.opd` is open with its diameter-3 mm circle sketch on the top face ✔ When Extrude uses Default direction, Distance A 8 mm, zero taper and Join ✔ And OK is clicked ✔ Then a cylindrical boss and Extrusion2 are visible ✔ And the browser still shows Solid Bodies(1) ✔ When Undo is invoked ✔ Then the circular sketch returns and the boss disappears
